title: I would love suggestions for my game !!
author: Low-Shallot2140
selftext: Hi ! I made a game called METRO:LIFE. It's in the same style as BitLife, if anyone doesn't know what it's about, Bitlife is kind of a text based life simulator, and my game is just like that, I have tons of features, even maybe more than bitlife. But you can always add features to a game, and that's why I'm asking you guys some feature suggestions for me to add to my game, you are also very welcomed to ask me if you can playtest it, i will respond to your comment and send you the discord server. Thank you !!
